name: Dynamic Economy Modeling
consequences: Enhancing the in-game economy introduces emergent player-driven markets, potentially boosting replayability, but also requires sophisticated balancing to prevent exploitation. The added complexity may increase QA effort and extend release timelines.

review: Improving economic depth adds gameplay richness but does not resolve the risk of performance bottlenecks caused by large-scale simulation calculations.

Introduce a dynamic resolution scaling system that adjusts visual fidelity on lower-end devices without compromising core gameplay.
Partner with console manufacturers to access proprietary performance profiling tools, enabling targeted optimizations for each platform.
review: Ensuring cross-platform compatibility broadens audience but does not mitigate the risk of uneven user experience due to varying hardware capabilities.
